causes.message: No crash sentinel location set for crash handler
causes.cause: --multi intentionally constructs an inactive CrashHandler, but the main-window shutdown signal still invoked its sentinel cleanup.
causes.fix: Skip cleanup for inactive handlers; repeated shutdown notifications are also idempotent.

causes.message: Tried to call obs_frontend_remove_event_callback with no callbacks!
causes.cause: AudioMixer unregistered at EXIT and again in its destructor after the frontend API was destroyed. WebSocket EventHandler waited until module unload to unregister.
causes.fix: Track registration ownership; unregister at EXIT while the frontend exists, and skip duplicate destructor cleanup.
